description: Fresh question set written by a model that never saw the metric catalog (qwen2.5:3b, prompt and raw output in fresh_questions_raw.json). All generated questions are kept in order except one duplicate. Classified afterwards by natural meaning: kind 'catalog' (expect answer, ground truth from hand-written SQL), 'gap' (data exists but the catalog cannot express it: expect refuse), 'impossible' (no such data: expect refuse).

dropped.seed 22 #5: duplicate of seed 11 #17 (average time from order to actual delivery)

questions.question: How many unique products have been sold through our platform in Brazil during the specified period?
questions.note: Number of distinct products sold: no such metric.

questions.question: What is the total revenue generated from each payment method during the period September 2016 to October 2018?
questions.note: Money received per payment method over the whole period = payment value by payment type.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_type, ROUND(SUM(payment_value), 2) AS payment_value FROM warehouse.fact_payments GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: Which Brazilian state(s) saw the highest number of orders during the period September 2016 to October 2018?
questions.note: Orders per customer state over the whole period, highest first.
questions.ground_truth_sql: SELECT customer_state_std, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM warehouse.fact_orders GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
